tools.name: create_diagram
tools.description:
Creates and displays an interactive draw.io diagram from Mermaid.js syntax or draw.io XML — provide exactly one.

**Choose the format first.** Use `xml` for diagrams of boxes and lines up to about 30 shapes: flowcharts, pipelines, decision trees, org charts, ER schemas, UML class, state and use case

tools.name: search_shapes
tools.description: Search the draw.io shape library by keywords. Returns matching shapes with their exact style strings, dimensions, and titles. Covers ~10,000 built-in stencils (cloud architecture, network topology, P&ID, electrical, Cisco, Kubernetes, BPMN) and, when those are sparse, supplements results with the dr

tools.name: get_drawio_reference
tools.description: Returns the draw.io diagram generation reference as Markdown. Format "xml": styles, the layout grid, edges, containers, swimlanes, layers, tags, metadata, dark mode, the layout and routing passes, and the well-formedness rules for create_diagram's xml. Format "mermaid": the header keyword and syntax
